snippet.title: Beneath The Six - Gameplay Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Releasing in early access on Steam 14th August

✨ Wishlist now ✨ "Beneath The Six" on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126880?utm_source=Social&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campagin=publicbeta&utm_term=YouTube

Join Discord https://discord.gg/dnodice

Beneath The Six is a turn-based roguelike game (when we say ‘roguelike’ we mean literally ‘like Rogue’, the classic turn-based game dating right back to 1980 – ‘roguelike’ has come to mean lots of other things since, but our game owes its inspiration back to that original).

Beneath The Six is a mixture of exploration, combat and storytelling. Players create a character using their digital dice and descend, either alone or with friends, into dungeons filled with treasure, traps and enemies. Every day, a new dungeon will be generated with fresh challenges for players to tackle. With shifting combinations of enemies, traps and objectives, each dungeon calls for different strengths; one day might call for the stealth and agility of a Rogue, while the next could reward the arcane power of a Mage. 

Players are encouraged to experiment with different characters -  made from different combinations of digital dice. Characters come with their own skills, intelligence, strength, dexterity and equipment. A character that’s great in one situation might not be the ideal choice for another. Players might choose to enter the dungeons together, sharing the risks and rewards, perhaps choosing to play as characters with complementary skills.

We're launching first on PC and Mac, with plans to expand to mobile platforms later on.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
